summary: Frontend-only delta tested: WhatsApp Share + Save-PDF across Advisor, DiagnosisReport, and Market. All 5 new data-testids render, click handlers work correctly, no console errors, no regressions on /advisor /market /dashboard.

verifications.advisor_share_button: present (data-testid=advisor-share-button); navigator.share called with text length 1470 chars (>20). No exception.
verifications.advisor_save_pdf_button: present (data-testid=advisor-save-pdf-button); window.print invoked once via printElementBySelector against [data-testid=advisor-result] which has data-print-root attribute. No navigation, no exception.
verifications.diagnosis_share_button: present at /scan/<id> after seeding sessionStorage key 'scan:<id>'; navigator.share triggered with valid text payload.
verifications.listing_share_button: 3 buttons rendered on /market default mock listings; native share fired with 118-char text. wa.me fallback also constructs correct URL prefix.
verifications.wa_me_url: When navigator.share is absent, window.open receives URL starting with 'https://wa.me/?text=' (validated on market listing when native share was patched to fail).
verifications.regression: Dashboard weather card renders, EN<->हिं language toggle works, no unexpected console errors (only harmless Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warning per iteration notes).

critical_code_review_comments: share.js and print.js are small, focused, and dependency-free. Good separation of concerns.
shareContent silently swallows navigator.share rejection then falls back to wa.me — that is intentional per comment, acceptable UX.
print.js hard-cleanup timeout is 30s which is reasonable; still relies on afterprint on desktop Chrome. No issue observed.

Advisor.jsx line 386: data-print-root has no value so the CSS rule `[data-print-root]:not([data-print-root="active"])` will match it before activation and hide it — but that is only inside @media print + body.printing so it only affects an active print job. Behavior is correct.
seed_data_creation: None. Market page already had 3 mock listings — no listing seed needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Web Share and window.print are no-ops in headless; tests monkey-patch navigator.share, window.open, and window.print via add_init_script. Advisor's native <select> requires page.select_option(label=...), not get_by_role('option'). To render DiagnosisReport without hitting /api/diagnose, sessionStorage.setItem('scan:<id>', JSON.stringify(scan)) then navigate to /scan/<id>.
